sharedPrompt: One single small illuminated quadcopter drone, an isolated transparent PNG game sprite for a mobile drone light show. The drone is repeated at small sizes to build letters, so it needs a bold clean readable silhouette. Three-quarter front view from slightly above, level flight, symmetrical horizontal wingspan, a compact body with exactly four short arms and four small visible rotor pods, softly rounded propellers. One round bright LED lens centered on the front underside at approximately 50 percent image width and 58 percent image height. Gentle controlled light only around the lens, no huge aura. Full object centered, same visual weight across the set, generous clear alpha margins. 3D Soft Neomorphism with clean volumetric shading, premium game prop, no face, no eyes, no text, no logo, no particles, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow, no frame. Genuine transparent background. Body geometry and material must match the named theme, not simply recolor another drone. Target readability at 12 to 20 pixels.

Soft crafted relief and visible material depth without gritty texture, shiny metal, leaves or decorative attachments.
